transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've been having sinus congestion and drainage for the last several days. It's mostly just annoying stuffiness and post-nasal drip.
When did you first notice it?
It started about four or five days ago. It hasn't gotten much worse since then, just pretty steady.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
I haven't really noticed anything that clearly makes it better or worse. It just seems to be there most of the time.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It feels like pressure and stuffiness in my nose and behind my cheeks, and there's a drip that runs down the back of my throat. Not painful, just congested and annoying.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's mainly in my nose and behind my cheeks on both sides. It doesn't spread anywhere else — no headache or anything like that.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
I'd say it's mild — maybe a 2 or 3 out of 10. It's more of a nuisance than anything.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It's pretty much there all the time. It doesn't really come and go.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
No, nothing else has really been bothering me. I feel well overall — I still walk a mile or two most days. I do get up once a night to pass urine, but that's been going on a while.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I was diagnosed with diabetes last fall. I check my blood sugar about once a day, and my readings range from 82 to 132.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
I'm sorry, I can't remember the names of the medicines off the top of my head. I know I'm on something for my diabetes and a couple of other things, but I'd have to look at the bottles.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
Not that I know of — I haven't had any reactions to medicines.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
No, not at all. I've been feeling well otherwise — I still walk a mile or two most days, and use the mall when the weather's bad. The congestion hasn't slowed me down.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
Not really. Mostly I just wanted to get it checked since I have the diabetes now and wanted to be sure it's nothing more than a cold or allergy.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
